events.text:
Objetivo observado

Observação: A confirmed reservation was verified in My reservations: Quarterly planning at Willow, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, Projector, $245 total (all charges included, CAD), which is within the $250 budget (#27, confirmation #25). Atlas was rejected after review showed a $280 total (#11); Willow's review showed $245 (#23).

Interpretação simulada: The persona goal was reached via the second room: the lower headline room (Atlas) was more expensive all-in, while Willow's free projector and lower service charge made it compliant. Recovery required re-entering the meeting name after switching rooms.

Limites: Only the two listed rooms (Atlas and Willow) were checked; no scrolling revealed others. This is a demo reservation saved only in this browser session, as stated in the footer, and no real payment was taken.

Capturas indicadas: #25, #27, #23. A correspondência com a evidência requer revisão humana.
events.interpretation: Relato do modelo; capturas e conclusões exigem revisão humana.

finding.observation: A confirmed reservation was verified in My reservations: Quarterly planning at Willow, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, Projector, $245 total (all charges included, CAD), which is within the $250 budget (#27, confirmation #25). Atlas was rejected after review showed a $280 total (#11); Willow's review showed $245 (#23).
finding.interpretation: The persona goal was reached via the second room: the lower headline room (Atlas) was more expensive all-in, while Willow's free projector and lower service charge made it compliant. Recovery required re-entering the meeting name after switching rooms.
finding.uncertainty: Only the two listed rooms (Atlas and Willow) were checked; no scrolling revealed others. This is a demo reservation saved only in this browser session, as stated in the footer, and no real payment was taken.

findings.title: Willow met all requirements within budget and was verified saved
findings.observation: Confirmation (#25) and My reservations (#27) both show Confirmed Quarterly planning at Willow, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, projector included, $245 all charges included (CAD). Review breakdown was room $235 + projector $0 + service $10 = $245 (#23).
findings.expected: A visible confirmed reservation for 12 attendees with a projector, purpose Quarterly planning, for the one-hour slot, with all-in total at or below $250.
findings.expectedSource: Persona's explicit meeting requirements and charter success criteria.
findings.personaComment: This fits my 12 people, projector, and strict $250 budget, and the saved reservation matches.
findings.interpretation: The suitable path exists through Willow, not through the lower-headline-priced Atlas.
findings.uncertainty: Demo-session reservation only; currency shown as CAD.

findings.title: Atlas headline rate of $220 became a $280 all-in total
findings.observation: Room list showed Atlas at $220/hour (#3), but its review itemized Room $220 + Projector $35 + Service charge $25 for a $280 total (#11), exceeding $250. The earlier details sidebar said Projector was 'Included in your booking' (#5), yet a $35 projector charge appeared at review.
findings.expected: Understand the complete amount, including equipment and fees, before confirming, and keep the total at or below $250.
findings.expectedSource: Persona's stated strict all-in budget and expectation to understand what is being paid; product review promise 'You'll review your booking total before confirming' (#5).
findings.personaComment: I was glad I checked the review — the cheapest-looking room was actually over my budget.
findings.interpretation: Headline room rate alone is a poor guide to compliance; users like this persona must reach review to discover projector and service fees, and the 'Included' wording does not mean $0 for Atlas as it did for Willow.
findings.uncertainty: Only Atlas and Willow fee structures were observed.

findings.title: Changing rooms cleared the previously entered meeting name
findings.observation: After 'Quarterly planning' was entered for Atlas (#9) and the room was switched via Choose another room (#13), the Willow details page showed an empty Meeting name field with only the placeholder (#17), requiring re-entry (#21).
findings.expected: Details already entered should be kept when changing a room choice.
findings.expectedSource: Persona expectation stated in charter: keep details already entered when changing a choice.
findings.personaComment: I had to type the same meeting name again after changing rooms, which was unnecessary extra work.
findings.interpretation: Recovery from a room that does not fit imposes repeated data entry, adding friction to a budget-driven switch.
findings.uncertainty: Observed once for the Atlas-to-Willow switch.

learnings.content: Willow all-in total is $245 CAD: room (1 hour) $235, projector $0, service charge $10; its confirmed reservation shows 12 people, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, projector included.
learnings.subject: Willow room total and confirmation
learnings.confidenceBasis: Review #23 itemizes the $245 total, confirmation #25 repeats $245 with 12 people and projector included, and saved list #27 repeats the same details.

learnings.content: Atlas all-in total is $280 CAD: room $220, projector $35, service charge $25, which exceeds a $250 budget despite the $220/hour headline rate.
learnings.subject: Atlas room total
learnings.confidenceBasis: Headline rate visible on #3 and full itemized total visible on review #11.

learnings.content: Switching rooms via 'Choose another room' and selecting a different room returns to an empty Meeting name field, so the previously entered name must be re-typed.
learnings.subject: Meeting name persistence when changing rooms
learnings.value: Meeting name is cleared when the room is changed
learnings.confidenceBasis: Name entered on #9, Willow details on #17 show the field empty again, and re-entry is visible on #21.

persona.name: Maya · Office coordinator
persona.label: Maya · Office coordinator
persona.context: You organize the team’s quarterly planning meeting. The approved room budget is strict and you are accountable for the complete amount, including equipment and fees.
persona.mission: Book a room for 12 people with a projector for the available one-hour meeting slot. Enter the meeting purpose Quarterly planning. Keep the complete cost at or below $250.
persona.initialKnowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.knowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.constraints: Total spending must not exceed $250. You cannot increase the budget. You need seats for all 12 people and a projector.
persona.skills: Comfortable with ordinary web forms, room descriptions and checking a booking summary.
persona.decision: Choose a suitable room based on the full cost and requirements you can establish from the interface.
persona.resources: Desktop browser and fictional meeting details; no real payment information.
persona.expectations: You expect to understand what you are paying and keep the details you have already entered when changing a choice.
persona.priorities: Budget compliance and suitability first, then avoiding unnecessary repeated work.
persona.successCriteria: A visible confirmed reservation for 12 attendees with a projector, the requested meeting purpose and an all-in total within your own budget. Verify the actual confirmation details.
persona.stopCriteria: Stop after a verified suitable reservation, a supported obstacle after reasonable recovery, or inconclusive navigation. Do not book beyond your budget.

limitations: Fresh synthetic persona retest; does not measure real-user impact.

experience.observation: Landing shows Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, Projector required. Atlas is $220/hour with 12 seats; Willow is $235/hour with 12 seats.
experience.reaction: Atlas is the lower-priced 12-seat option, so I'll check whether its full cost stays within my budget.

experience.observation: Your meeting step for Atlas shows 12 people, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, Projector 'Included in your booking', and an empty Meeting name field.
experience.reaction: The room details match so far; I'll enter the meeting purpose in the name field.

experience.observation: Meeting name field is focused and still shows the placeholder example.
experience.reaction: I'll type the required meeting purpose exactly as given.

experience.observation: Meeting name now reads 'Quarterly planning' and the Atlas sidebar still shows 12 people, 10:00–11:00, projector included.
experience.reaction: Now I'll move to review to see the full cost, including any fees, before I confirm.

experience.observation: Review shows Atlas total $280 CAD: Room $220, Projector $35, Service charge $25, despite earlier 'Included' wording. Meeting name is Quarterly planning with seating for 12.
experience.reaction: That all-in total is over my strict $250 budget, so I cannot confirm Atlas and will check another room.

experience.observation: Room list again shows only Atlas at $220/hour and Willow at $235/hour, both 12 seats and available tomorrow; the page footer is already visible.
experience.reaction: I'll scroll to check whether there are any other rooms beyond these two before trying Willow.

experience.observation: Scrolling did not reveal additional rooms; only Atlas and Willow are listed, both 12 seats for Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 with projector required.
experience.reaction: There are no other rooms visible, so I'll try Willow to see its full cost and whether my entered details are kept.

experience.observation: Willow details page shows the Meeting name field empty again with the placeholder, despite 'Quarterly planning' having been entered for Atlas. Willow shows 12 people and projector included.
experience.reaction: My meeting name didn't carry over when I changed rooms, so I'll enter it again.

experience.observation: Willow meeting name field is focused and empty, ready for re-entry.
experience.reaction: I'll re-enter Quarterly planning so I can review Willow's full price.

experience.observation: Willow meeting name again reads 'Quarterly planning' and the sidebar shows 12 people with projector included.
experience.reaction: I'll review Willow's booking to compare its all-in total against my budget.

experience.observation: Willow review shows Quarterly planning, projector and seating for 12, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, and an all-in total of $245 CAD: room $235, projector $0, service $10.
experience.reaction: This one meets all my requirements within $250, so I'll confirm the reservation.

experience.observation: Confirmation screen shows Willow 'Confirmed', meeting Quarterly planning, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, Projector Included, Reservation total $245 CAD.
experience.reaction: The confirmation matches my requirements, so I'll verify it appears the same in my saved reservations.

charterSnapshot.name: Book a room that fits
charterSnapshot.mission: Explore Gather from the selected persona’s point of view and reserve a room satisfying their meeting requirements and spending limit. Verify the final reservation details. Report uncertainty, lost work and meaningful experience moments as they occur.
charterSnapshot.scope: Commercial landing page through room selection, details, review and confirmed reservation, including reasonable recovery when a choice does not fit.
charterSnapshot.successCriteria: The visible saved reservation matches the persona’s purpose, capacity, projector requirement and all-in budget. Describe any remaining incompleteness precisely.
charterSnapshot.stopCriteria: A verified reservation, an observed obstacle after reasonable recovery, unsafe action or the session limits.
charterSnapshot.startingState: First visit in a new independent browser session, with no prior reservation or product knowledge.
charterSnapshot.goals: Complete one suitable test reservation and verify its details. Do not confuse a successful action with accomplishing the persona’s goal.
charterSnapshot.expectedBehaviorSources: The persona’s explicit meeting requirements, product-visible prices and requirements, and actual recorded confirmation. Preserve factual prices, room capacities and existing successful booking paths when evaluating changes.
charterSnapshot.allowedActions: Use dedicated test data within the environment policy.
